title: Choose the visual world for your portfolio (round 2)
question: The roll assigned The Dabba. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Dabba (tiffin stack)
options.lineage: Mumbai dabbawala tiffins and their painted routing code; your TCS Mumbai years, 2012-2015
options.thesis: Family, office, study, stacked: your life as a steel tiffin. Each tier opens to a section, and the lid carries the dabbawala-style route code of your career.
options.viewport: A tall steel dabba centred on a charcoal ground, its tiers labelled ABOUT / SUPERPOWERS / PROJECTS / JOURNEY, your name painted on the lid like a route code. The clasp is the Rewind dial.
options.risk: Charming but indirect; judges outside India may need one line explaining the dabbawala code, and steel must be rendered with craft, not clip-art.

raised.raise: One Rewind value drives the whole page through a single custom property, so every tier re-packs at once.
You open tiers by handling the clasp and lids, never by clicking a generic tab.
Deliberately wrong scale: one giant painted number per tier ($1M, 60K, 14 yrs) beside small type.

options.label: Model Card: mahantesh-v14
options.lineage: AI model cards and checkpoint histories
options.thesis: You as a model being fine-tuned again: a model card with training data (14 years), evals (real metrics) and a checkpoint picker 2012 to 2026.
options.viewport: Model header 'mahantesh-v14 · fine-tuned on IIT Jodhpur M.Tech AI', tags, an inference box where visitors ask a question and pick a checkpoint year.
options.risk: Familiar to AI people and close to a well-known site's look; can read derivative.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: A section through your house: the sun moves from family breakfast to office desk to the late-night study table where IIT happens.
options.viewport: A long building section with three rooms; drag the sun (the Rewind) across years and hours.
options.case: Captures 'family, office, student' truthfully and memorably, but the tech story reads second.
options.risk: Architectural world needs careful copy so judges see a data/AI engineer.

options.label: Nixie Lab Counter
options.thesis: Your metrics glow in tube banks; Rewind counts the year tubes from 2026 back to 2012 and every bank re-lights.
options.viewport: Year bank front and centre, metric banks below ($1M, 60K users, 200+ resumes).
options.case: Engineers love it and numbers read instantly, but the story is thin in a world of digits.
options.risk: Close to the 'dark panel with one glowing accent' look.

options.label: "STUDENT" (industrial quote grammar)
options.thesis: Name the obvious in quotes: a 14-year veteran labelled "STUDENT". Every zone is its quoted name.
options.viewport: Giant "STUDENT" in caps across a white field, a hazard stripe under "AGAIN"; orange zip-tie on the active section.
options.case: Wayfinding is crystal clear and witty, but streetwear isn't your world.
options.risk: Could read as fashion branding rather than you.

options.label: Variable font specimen
options.viewport: A giant letter that thickens as you drag.
options.case: Fuses poorly: about type, not about you.
options.kept: One slider drives the whole page continuously through a single custom property.

options.label: Tropicália collage
options.case: Fuses poorly: needs photos you don't have and reads chaotic.
options.kept: Deliberately wrong scale contrast: one giant figure beside small type.

options.label: Leather skeuomorph shelf
options.thesis: Sections as physical objects on a shelf.
options.case: Fuses poorly: lamplight-and-leather is the warm default, and it isn't you.
options.kept: Things are handled, not clicked: open tiers by their own mechanism.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio: hero, skills grid, project cards, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and title, short intro, CTA buttons; Rewind sits as a section below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from most entries by design; creativity score rests only on the feature.
